evidence.FACTS: Fuel rule added from search results (seen in search result, 2026-10-30): since 1 June 2026 only E10 and E5 RON 92 are sold (E10 replaced RON 95), most recent vehicles are E10-compatible per manufacturers, Honda Vietnam motorcycles designed for RON 91+ and up to 10% ethanol; older models are the case to check; phrased with attribution. Unconfirmed shop policy removed: old text implied agencies deliver with fill-level/forfait and described 'notre page' what is included (deposit, assistance); now fuel level at pickup, return rule (same level/full/forfait) and carburant type are questions to ask this shop, 'aucune règle n'est confirmée'. No petrol price, no tank capacity, no model spec given (FAQ points to honda.com.vn / yamaha-motor.com.vn). Vietnamese vocabulary (xăng, cây xăng/trạm xăng, đổ đầy, đổ 50 nghìn, bao nhiêu tiền, cảm ơn) is general knowledge; 20 000/500 000 VND note confusion is general tourist knowledge, qualified. Hours 09:00-21:00 and phone from SEO-FACTS. Petrolimex/PVOIL named only as national chains.
